mapper.select: /* CastUserConfigMapper.retrieveChknList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 0, 1) AS ISLAND, PMOWN.FN_PM_SAFE_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 2, 2)) AS COUNTER_NUM, A.ALN_CD, PMOWN.FN_PM_SAFE_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.EST_BGNG_HM, 0, 2)) AS "START", CEIL((A.EST_END_HM) / 100) AS "END" FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CKNCT_DALY_ALOT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.OPER_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ISLAND, COUNTER_NUM, A.ALN_CD
